question:
Identify the figure given in the options which when put in place of ? will logically complete the series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b29b415c8d77229b65ef9cf8164bca20b44e9c276b82363722d8ac6867506ecd.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Numbers are shifting their position starting from middle to bottom-left corner number.

Bottom-left number is removed in each figure and a new number is added in middle of the position.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9d2db161f9cb893fb7f2f2e6868a1ce3826b9ee47dfec727aab3f80e3c287847.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 3".**
